browser_harness_history: Initial and diagnostic starts failed because standalone bundle lacked browser process.env replacement; logs and startup JSON preserved, not app failures.
Next build failed because hash walker treated esbuild virtual define module as a real file; log preserved, skipped virtual inputs in research metadata.
Two immediate-focus checks failed around BaseUI deferred focus guards; raw fast snapshot/log preserved. No BaseUI production defect registered.
Final run samples after two animation frames, all 14 observations completed exit 0; genuine busy ConfirmDialog focus escape remains, BaseUI background check passes. No application edits.
radio_observation: APG keyboard pattern divergence, but Tab/Space completion works; not labeled full keyboard inaccessibility or a new security defect

peertube_partial_review.scope: Selected NgbModal confirm/service and report lifecycle/template, native checkbox, content-language selector (not UI locale selector), Weblate/XLIFF translation workflow.
limitations: NgbModal dependency used but its installed runtime not tested
Confirm closes before emitting response, so no equivalent pending-state benchmark
Comment report opens with keyboard:false, so not automatically better Escape behavior
Checkbox supports multiple reasons, different semantics from Polutek single radio choice
Weblate workflow does not certify translation quality or full language completeness
